### mount aspectChart
<section class="chart-group aspect-contrast" data-tone="aspect-core">
<header class="chart-group-head">
<h3>
Core contrast
</h3>
</header>
<div class="chart-table">
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
Shape
</h4>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Imperfective">
<p>
process, duration
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Пишем писмо.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I am writing a letter.
</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Perfective">
<p>
result, boundary
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Написаћу писмо.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I will write the letter.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
Repeat
</h4>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Imperfective">
<p>
habit, repeated action
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Читам свако вече.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I read every evening.
</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Perfective">
<p>
one completed event
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Прочитао сам књигу.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I finished the book.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
Present
</h4>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Imperfective">
<p>
now or generally
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Гледам филм.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I am watching a film.
</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="chart-cell aspect-side" data-label="Perfective">
<p>
future, sequence, condition
</p>
<div class="chart-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Кад погледам, рећи ћу ти.
</span>
<span class="tr">
When I take a look, I will tell you.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</section>

</span>
<span class="tr">

</span>

</span>

</span>
</div>

<div class="chart-cell" data-label="Perfective">

<span class="tr">
will write and finish
</span>
</div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</section>
<section class="chart-group aspect-patterns" data-tone="aspect-pattern">
<header class="chart-group-head">
<h3>
Pair patterns
</h3>
</header>
<div class="chart-table">
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
bare verb + prefix
</h4>
<div class="chart-form aspect-form aspect-pair" lang="sr">
<span>
писати
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
->
</span>
<span>
написати
</span>
</div>
<p>
finished text
</p>
</article>
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
secondary imperfective
</h4>
<div class="chart-form aspect-form aspect-pair" lang="sr">
<span>
отварати
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
->
</span>
<span>
отворити
</span>
</div>
<p>
open repeatedly / be opening
</p>
</article>
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
suffix pair
</h4>
<div class="chart-form aspect-form aspect-pair" lang="sr">
<span>
куповати
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
->
</span>
<span>
купити
</span>
</div>
<p>
buying vs one purchase
</p>
</article>
<article class="chart-row">
<h4>
stem-change pair
</h4>
<div class="chart-form aspect-form aspect-pair" lang="sr">
<span>
узимати
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
->
</span>
<span>
узети
</span>
</div>
<p>
taking vs one take
</p>
</article>
</div>
</section>

### popover [data-aspect-note]|[["data-aspect-note","0"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
na- is not only completion
</h4>
<p>
The prefix can also mean onto, up, or enough. Treat the pair as a lexical fact first, and the prefix as a useful hint second.
</p>
</article>
### popover [data-aspect-note]|[["data-aspect-note","1"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
po- is broad
</h4>
<p>
It often marks a bounded action: take a look, wait a bit, talk for a while. The exact feel depends on the verb.
</p>
</article>
### popover [data-aspect-note]|[["data-aspect-note","2"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
Motion verbs compress patterns
</h4>
<p>
Motion pairs often have extra stem changes. Keep them visible, but do not use them as the model for every verb.
</p>
</article>
